applications.title: Build your next team.
applications.text: Keep separate role openings active at once. Close an opening when hiring pauses, then reopen the same link next time—past responses and one-time submissions stay attached.
applications.introText: Each opening has its own stable public link and response archive.
applications.updateDetail: Changes apply to the existing link. Previously submitted answers remain attached.
applications.createDetail: One saved opening per role and hiring round. Reopen it later to reuse its URL.

applications.descriptionPlaceholder: Share what the role involves and who you’re looking for.
applications.eligibilityHint: Applicants need at least one selected role. Leave empty to allow any server member.
applications.questionsHint: Ask up to 12 questions. Required answers must be completed.
applications.questionPlaceholder: Why would you be a good fit?
applications.footerKeep: The share link and existing responses are kept.
applications.footerNew: Your public application link requires Discord sign-in and server membership.
applications.asideText: Niko confirms membership directly with Discord before showing or submitting a form. Selected role gates are checked against the applicant’s current server roles.
